name: Toran Restaurant (GTDC)
signature_dish: Vada, poha, and the cleanest food near the temple
why_it_matters: Gujarat Tourism's Toran restaurant just outside the Modhera Sun Temple premises — the only meaningful sit-down food within walking distance of the 11th-century temple. Snacks (vada, poha, kachori), light meals, masala chai. Most reviewer-consensus answer: 'the only good restaurant in the vicinity.' Compact, cafeteria-style, GTDC-clean.
insider_tip: Don't expect a full Gujarati thali every day — the kitchen rotates a small menu. Snacks (vada, poha, samosa) are the reliable orders. Best as a pre-temple breakfast (it opens early) or a post-temple chai stop. Most visitors do a half-day Modhera + half-day Patan; pack a thali at Patan instead of relying on Modhera for lunch.
signature_address: Outside Modhera Sun Temple Gate, Modhera Village, Mehsana District, Gujarat 384212

name: Saffrony Holiday Resort Restaurant
signature_dish: Resort-restaurant Gujarati thali for tour groups
why_it_matters: The closest resort with a proper restaurant — sits on the highway between Modhera and Mehsana. Tour buses doing Modhera + Patan + Vadnagar often park here for lunch. The thali is decent (not exceptional) and the kitchen handles multi-cuisine for tour-group preferences. Wins by being closer to the temple than the Mehsana hotel cluster (where most lunch options actually are).
insider_tip: Lunch hours (12:30-2:30pm) are the only window worth attending — outside that, the kitchen runs leaner. Tour bus crowds can take 30-40 min for refills; if you're a small group, ask the captain to prioritise your table. Skip if you're going on to Patan for lunch instead — same quality, different distance.
signature_address: Modhera-Mehsana State Highway, Modhera Village, Mehsana District, Gujarat 384212
